name: Blueberry & Almond Smoothie Bowl
steps: Chuck the blueberries, blackberries, banana, milk, yoghurt, protein powder, almond butter, the juice of the lime and chia seeds into a blender.
Start blending on a low speed. Use a tamper to push everything down – it’ll be thick. Add 10ml more milk at a time only if it really won’t blend.
Scoop into a bowl and load up with your favourite toppings – fresh berries, granola, almonds, seeds or another drizzle of almond butter.
